title: Visiting Assistant Professor of Law
bio: Oladeji M. Tiamiyu is a Visiting Assistant Professor of Law at Harvard Law School. He is also an Assistant Professor of Law at the University of Denver and an Executive Member of the AALS Dispute Resolution committee. Professor Tiamiyu also serves as an Expert Adviser to early-stage ventures at Harvard’s Innovation Lab. Previously, he was […]
